customer_id.meaning: primary id of the patient profile (seed uuid or content hash); one profile per registered patient of the group

name.meaning: patient's legal full name exactly as registered at the front desk and shown on the photo identification presented at first registration

date_of_birth.meaning: patient's date of birth as registered on the patient profile

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on the patient profile, used for appointment reminders and call-back

email.meaning: email address on the patient profile, used for portal notices and paperless statements; empty when none is on file

medical_record_number.meaning: the patient's medical record number (MRN) assigned by the group at first registration; printed on visit summaries and statements

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the patient's Social Security number as captured at registration; empty when the patient declined to provide it

mailing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the patient's mailing address on file (where paper statements and records are mailed)

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the patient profile was first created (first registration with the group)

portal_status.meaning: state of the patient's MyLinden patient-portal account: active = can sign in; not_enrolled = never activated; locked = access suspended after failed sign-ins or at patient request

primary_care_clinician.meaning: name of the patient's assigned primary care clinician as recorded on the profile (e.g. 'Dr. Priya Raman, MD'); empty when none is assigned

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record (content hash of the patient id); one record per patient, upserted

customer_id.meaning: patient whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; monotonically non-decreasing — once true it never reverts to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the handoff record (content hash of patient id and reason)

customer_id.meaning: patient handed over to a human representative (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

billing_account_id.meaning: primary id of the Patient Financial Account

customer_id.meaning: patient the account belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: financial class currently recorded on the account, written as the official tier name; the tier governing a charge is the one in force on its date of service

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the account (basis: billing lifecycle.states)

closed_date.meaning: date the closure took effect; empty while the account is open

payer_name.meaning: insurance payer name exactly as printed on the patient's card (e.g. 'Buckeye Health Plan'); empty on the Self-Pay Account

member_number.meaning: insurance member number exactly as printed on the card; empty on the Self-Pay Account

coverage_effective_date.meaning: date the coverage now recorded became effective (card or payer response); for the Self-Pay Account, the date self-pay status began

coverage_verified_date.meaning: date eligibility of the recorded coverage was last verified with the payer; empty until first verified

copay_primary_usd.meaning: primary care office-visit copay of the recorded coverage per the payer eligibility response; 0.00 when none

copay_specialist_usd.meaning: specialist copay of the recorded coverage per the payer eligibility response; 0.00 when none

deductible_remaining_usd.meaning: remaining individual deductible of the recorded coverage as of coverage_verified_date; 0.00 when met or not applicable

hold_reason.meaning: why the account is on billing hold; none when not on hold

hold_started_date.meaning: date the current billing hold started; empty when not on hold

final_notice_date.meaning: date the final notice of the current escalation was issued; empty unless the account is in precollection or collections

collections_placed_date.meaning: date the balance was placed with the collection agency; empty unless in collections

hardship_approved_pct.meaning: adjustment percentage approved by the most recent financial-hardship review; 0.00 when none or denied

hardship_approved_through.meaning: last date of service covered by the hardship approval; empty when none

patient_balance.format: USD, 2 decimal places, may be negative
patient_balance.meaning: current amount owed by the patient; identically the sum of the patient_balance account deltas (charges, refunds and reversals positive; payments, copays and adjustments negative); negative means a credit

last_statement_date.meaning: date of the most recent statement issued; empty when none

card_on_file.meaning: whether a payment card is stored for post-adjudication charging

billing_txn_id.meaning: primary id of one ledger row of the account

billing_account_id.meaning: account the row belongs to (foreign key -> billing_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the billing charter

txn_date.meaning: posting date of the row (charge posting, payment receipt, adjustment, refund, reversal or statement date)

service_date.meaning: date of service the charge belongs to; for a late fee, the date of the statement it is charged on; for a returned-payment fee, the return date; empty on non-charge rows

encounter_number.meaning: the visit encounter the row relates to, as printed on statements and visit summaries; empty for account-level rows

line_category.meaning: what a charge is for; none on non-charge rows

amount.meaning: magnitude of the row; its sign on the patient balance comes from the event family's direction (charges, refunds and reversals raise the balance; copays, payments and adjustments lower it); for a statement, the statement balance

estimate_amount.meaning: estimate given before the service for the encounter (Good Faith Estimate for self-pay, insurance estimate otherwise); 0.00 when none or on non-charge rows

payment_method.meaning: method of a payment, collection, refund or reversed payment; none on charges, adjustments and statements

adjustment_code.meaning: reason of an adjustment; none on every other row

applies_to_txn_id.meaning: the ledger row this row acts on: the charge a copay/payment/adjustment is applied to, the payment a refund or reversal acts on; empty on charges and statements

statement_sequence.meaning: position of a statement in the current unpaid series (1 = first); 0 on non-statement rows

source_category.meaning: product line whose occurrence produced the row

signed_waiver_date.meaning: date of the patient's signed advance notice of non-coverage for a non-covered service charge; empty when none

billing_case_id.meaning: primary id of the billing case

billing_account_id.meaning: account the case concerns (foreign key -> billing_accounts)

billing_txn_id.meaning: the charge the case concerns (foreign key -> billing_transactions); empty for account-level cases

case_status.meaning: status of the case: open until decided; patient_confirmed only for account_closure cases the patient has confirmed

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

appointment_id.meaning: primary id of the booked visit

variant_name.meaning: visit type booked, written as the official tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the visit (basis: appointment lifecycle.states)

scheduled_date.meaning: date of the visit (after any reschedule)

scheduled_time.meaning: start time of the visit (after any reschedule)

clinician_name.meaning: clinician the visit is with, exactly as listed in the provider directory (e.g. 'Dr. Marcus Ellery, DO')

clinic_location.meaning: clinic the visit is at, exactly as listed in the location directory (e.g. 'Linden Ridge Westerville')

encounter_number.meaning: encounter number assigned at booking; the same number appears on the visit's billing rows

referral_id.meaning: referral or authorization the visit is booked against (foreign key -> referrals); empty when none

reschedule_count.meaning: number of patient-requested reschedules of this appointment

last_rescheduled_date.meaning: date of the most recent reschedule; empty when never rescheduled

confirmed_date.meaning: date the patient confirmed; empty when unconfirmed

checked_in_at.meaning: clock time of check-in; empty until checked in

arrival_minutes_late.meaning: whole minutes after the scheduled start at check-in; 0 when on time, early, or not checked in

cancelled_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
cancelled_at.meaning: moment the cancellation was recorded; empty unless cancelled

cancel_reason.meaning: why the visit was cancelled; none unless cancelled

cancel_timing.meaning: timing class of the cancellation per the cancellation rules; not_cancelled unless cancelled

deposit_held_usd.meaning: booking deposit currently held on the visit; identically the sum of the booking_deposit account deltas (collections positive, releases negative)

closed_date.meaning: date the visit closed as completed, cancelled or no-show; empty while open

appointment_event_id.meaning: primary id of one appointment ledger row

appointment_id.meaning: visit the row belongs to (foreign key -> appointments)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the appointment charter

service_date.meaning: scheduled date of the visit the fee or waiver concerns; empty on deposit rows

fee_type.meaning: fee assessed or waived; none on deposit rows

waiver_reason.meaning: why a fee was waived; none on other rows

amount.meaning: fee assessed, amount waived, deposit collected or deposit released; direction on the booking deposit comes from the event family

payment_method.meaning: how a deposit was paid; none on other rows

disposition.meaning: what happened to a released deposit; none on other rows

applies_to_event_id.meaning: the assessed fee row a waiver removes; empty when the fee was waived at assessment or on other rows

waitlist_id.meaning: primary id of the waitlist entry

appointment_id.meaning: the open appointment the patient wants moved earlier (foreign key -> appointments); empty when the patient holds none

variant_name.meaning: visit type the entry is waiting for

department.meaning: department the entry is waiting for

requested_by_date.meaning: latest date the patient wants the earlier slot to fall on; the entry expires after it

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: moment the entry was created (its place in the offer order)

referral_id.meaning: primary id of the referral or authorization case

variant_name.meaning: referral or authorization type, written as the official tier name

submitted_date.meaning: date the request was submitted for decision; empty until submitted

decision_date.meaning: date of the most recent decision (approval, denial, appeal outcome, extension or finalisation); empty until decided

specialty.meaning: department or service line the referral is for; matches the department of visits booked against it

referring_clinician.meaning: ordering clinician exactly as listed in the provider directory

rendering_provider.meaning: provider or site authorized to render the service, exactly as listed in the provider or facility directory

payer_auth_number.meaning: authorization number issued by the payer (or the in-group referral number), exactly as issued; empty until approved

valid_from.meaning: first date of service the referral covers; empty until approved

valid_through.meaning: last date of service the referral covers (after any extension); empty until approved

units_remaining.meaning: units still covered; identically the sum of the authorized_units account deltas (grants and restorations positive, uses and lapses negative)

extension_count.meaning: number of extensions granted on this referral

last_decision_basis.meaning: what the most recent approval decided; none until approved

denial_reason.meaning: reason stated in the denial; none unless denied

appeal_filed_date.meaning: date the most recent appeal was filed; empty when none

appeal_level.meaning: level of the most recent appeal (1 = first); 0 when none

cancel_reason.meaning: why the referral was cancelled; none unless cancelled

closed_date.meaning: date the referral closed (final denial, expiry or cancellation); empty while open

referral_event_id.meaning: primary id of one unit-ledger row

referral_id.meaning: referral the row belongs to (foreign key -> referrals)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the referral charter

unit_date.meaning: date of the grant decision, the completed visit, the restoration or the lapse

units.meaning: number of units in the row; direction on authorized_units comes from the event family

grant_reason.meaning: why units were granted; none on other rows

encounter_number.meaning: encounter that used (or whose use is restored) the unit; empty on grant and lapse rows

source_category.meaning: product line whose occurrence produced the row

applies_to_unit_event_id.meaning: the unit-use row a restoration reverses; empty on other rows

restore_reason.meaning: why a unit use was in error; none on other rows

forfeit_reason.meaning: why units lapsed; none on other rows

referral_request_id.meaning: primary id of the referral service request

referral_id.meaning: referral the request concerns (foreign key -> referrals)

request_status.meaning: status of the request; patient_signed when the patient has given a consent or acknowledgement only they can give

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

variant_name.meaning: prescription class, written as the official tier name

transmitted_date.meaning: date it was transmitted to the pharmacy; empty until transmitted

medication_name.meaning: medication exactly as written on the prescription (e.g. 'atorvastatin')

strength.meaning: strength and dosage form exactly as written (e.g. '20 mg tablet')

days_supply.meaning: days' supply of one regular fill

prescriber_name.meaning: prescribing clinician exactly as listed in the provider directory

prescribing_department.meaning: department of the prescriber; visits in this department satisfy the renewal visit requirement

pharmacy_name.meaning: pharmacy the prescription is at, exactly as listed in the pharmacy directory (e.g. 'Kroger Pharmacy #0412 Hilliard')

refills_remaining.meaning: fills the prescription still authorizes; identically the sum of the authorized_fills account deltas (authorizations positive, dispensings and voids negative)

expiration_date.meaning: last date the prescription may be filled

renewal_requested_date.meaning: date the current or most recent renewal request was received; empty when none

renewal_channel.meaning: channel of the current or most recent renewal request

renewed_date.meaning: date of the most recent renewal approval; empty when never renewed

hold_reason.meaning: what a held renewal is waiting for; none unless on hold

hold_started_date.meaning: date the current hold started; empty when not on hold

prior_auth_status.meaning: payer prior-authorization status of the medication

last_monitoring_lab_date.meaning: result date of the latest monitoring lab for this medication; empty when none

last_drug_screen_date.meaning: date of the latest drug screen; empty when none

controlled_agreement_signed_date.meaning: date the patient signed the current controlled-substance agreement; empty when none

pdmp_checked_date.meaning: date of the latest prescription-monitoring database (OARRS) check; empty when none

transfer_count.meaning: number of pharmacy transfers of this prescription

discontinue_reason.meaning: why the prescription was discontinued; none otherwise

closed_date.meaning: date the prescription expired or was discontinued; empty while open

rx_event_id.meaning: primary id of one fill-ledger row

prescription_id.meaning: prescription the row belongs to (foreign key -> prescriptions)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the rx charter

fill_date.meaning: date of the authorization, dispensing or void

fills.meaning: fills in the row; direction on authorized_fills comes from the event family

days_supply_per_fill.meaning: days' supply of each authorized fill or of the fill dispensed; 0 on void rows

authorization_reason.meaning: why fills were authorized; none on dispensing and void rows

fill_basis.meaning: basis of a dispensing; none on other rows

dispensing_pharmacy.meaning: pharmacy that dispensed the fill, exactly as reported; empty on other rows

void_reason.meaning: why fills were voided; none on other rows

police_report_number.meaning: police report number supporting a stolen-medication replacement, exactly as the patient gives it; empty otherwise

payment_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the payment plan

billing_account_id.meaning: financial account whose charges the plan covers (foreign key -> billing_accounts)

variant_name.meaning: plan tier, written as the official tier name

agreement_signed_date.meaning: date the patient signed the agreement; empty until signed

first_due_date.meaning: due date of installment 1; empty until signed

due_day.meaning: day of the month installments fall due

term_months.meaning: number of monthly installments currently scheduled (after any extension or restart)

installment_amount.meaning: current monthly installment (the final installment absorbs rounding)

down_payment_usd.meaning: down payment due at signing; 0.00 where none

remaining_balance.meaning: balance still owed under the plan; identically the sum of the plan_balance account deltas (enrollments positive; payments, reductions and releases negative)

autopay_method.meaning: automatic debit method; none when autopay is off

delinquent_since.meaning: date the plan became delinquent; empty unless delinquent

defaulted_date.meaning: date of the most recent default; empty when never defaulted

reinstated_date.meaning: date of the most recent reinstatement; empty when never reinstated

paused_through.meaning: last date of the current or most recent pause; empty when never paused

term_extension_months_used.meaning: total months the term has been extended

cancel_reason.meaning: how a closed plan ended; none while open or defaulted

closed_date.meaning: date the plan was paid off, cancelled or withdrawn; empty otherwise

payplan_txn_id.meaning: primary id of one plan ledger row

payment_plan_id.meaning: plan the row belongs to (foreign key -> payment_plans)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the payplan charter

txn_date.meaning: date of the enrollment, payment, miss, reduction or release

amount.meaning: magnitude of the row; direction on plan_balance comes from the event family

billing_txn_id.meaning: the billing charge enrolled or reduced (foreign key -> billing_transactions); empty on other rows

enroll_reason.meaning: why balance was enrolled; none on other rows

installment_number.meaning: installment paid or missed (1 = first); 0 on other rows

payment_method.meaning: how a payment was made; none on non-payment rows

channel.meaning: where a payment was received (system for autopay)

autopay.meaning: whether an installment payment was an automatic debit; false on other rows

extra_kind.meaning: kind of extra payment; none on other rows

adjustment_reason.meaning: why an enrolled charge was reduced; none on other rows

release_reason.meaning: why balance left the plan; none on other rows

telehealth_visit_id.meaning: primary id of the virtual encounter

variant_name.meaning: encounter type, written as the official tier name

scheduled_date.meaning: date of a scheduled visit; for e-visits and on-demand visits, the date it was picked up; empty until then

scheduled_time.meaning: start time of a scheduled visit; empty otherwise

clinician_name.meaning: clinician exactly as listed in the provider directory; empty until assigned

encounter_number.meaning: encounter number; the same number appears on the encounter's billing rows

patient_location_state.meaning: state the patient is physically in, as stated at request and attested at the start

referral_id.meaning: referral covering a specialty follow-up (foreign key -> referrals); empty otherwise

prepaid_balance_usd.meaning: prepayment currently held on the encounter; identically the sum of the visit_prepayment account deltas

connected_minutes.meaning: minutes the patient and clinician were connected; 0 until closed

end_reason.meaning: how a completed encounter ended; none otherwise

cancel_timing.meaning: timing class of a cancellation; not_cancelled otherwise

converted_appointment_id.meaning: in-person appointment booked for a conversion (foreign key -> appointments); empty otherwise

closed_date.meaning: date the encounter closed; empty while open

telehealth_event_id.meaning: primary id of one virtual-care ledger row

telehealth_visit_id.meaning: encounter the row belongs to (foreign key -> telehealth_visits)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the telehealth charter

service_date.meaning: date of the encounter a fee concerns; empty on prepayment rows

amount.meaning: prepayment collected or released, fee charged or waived; direction on visit_prepayment comes from the event family

payment_method.meaning: how a prepayment was paid; none on other rows

disposition.meaning: what happened to a released prepayment; none on other rows

fee_type.meaning: fee charged or waived; none on prepayment rows

waiver_reason.meaning: why a fee was waived; none on other rows

applies_to_event_id.meaning: the assessed fee row a waiver removes; empty otherwise

records_request_id.meaning: primary id of the records request

customer_id.meaning: patient whose records are requested (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: request type, written as the official tier name

recipient_name.meaning: recipient exactly as named on the request or authorization (the patient's own name for a patient copy)

delivery_method.meaning: how the records are to be delivered

record_scope.meaning: what part of the record is requested

fee_balance_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, may be negative
fee_balance_usd.meaning: fee still owed on the request; identically the sum of the records_fee_balance account deltas (assessments and refunds positive; payments, waivers and transfers negative)

authorization_requested_date.meaning: date the authorization form was sent; empty when none was needed

authorization_signed_date.meaning: date the authorization was signed; empty until signed

authorization_expiration_date.meaning: date the signed authorization expires; empty when none

due_date.meaning: date by which the records must be delivered (after any extension); empty until processing starts

extension_notice_date.meaning: date the extension notice was sent; empty when none

fulfilled_date.meaning: date the records were delivered; empty until fulfilled

page_count.meaning: pages released; 0 until fulfilled or for electronic exports without pages

denial_ground.meaning: ground of a denial; none otherwise

cancel_reason.meaning: why a request was cancelled; none otherwise

closed_date.meaning: date the request was fulfilled, denied or cancelled; empty while open

records_event_id.meaning: primary id of one fee-ledger row

records_request_id.meaning: request the row belongs to (foreign key -> records_requests)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the records charter

amount.meaning: magnitude of the row; direction on records_fee_balance comes from the event family

fee_component.meaning: fee component assessed; none on other rows

page_count.meaning: pages a page fee is computed on; 0 on other rows

payment_method.meaning: method of a payment or refund; none on other rows

waiver_reason.meaning: why a fee was waived; none on other rows

applies_to_event_id.meaning: the payment row a refund returns; empty on other rows

variant_name.meaning: membership tier, written as the official tier name

activated_date.meaning: date the membership started; empty while pending

dues_amount_usd.meaning: dues per cycle including dependent add-ons

commitment_end_date.meaning: date the minimum commitment ends (moved later by frozen months); empty while pending

current_period_start.meaning: first day of the current dues period; empty while pending

credits_remaining.meaning: member visit credits available; identically the sum of the member_visit_credits account deltas

freeze_start_date.meaning: first day of the current or most recent freeze; empty when never frozen

freeze_end_date.meaning: last day of the current or most recent freeze; empty when never frozen

freeze_months_used.meaning: months frozen in the current membership year (resets on the activation anniversary)

past_due_since.meaning: date the membership became past due; empty unless past due

cancel_notice_date.meaning: date of the pending cancellation notice; empty otherwise

cancel_effective_date.meaning: date the pending cancellation takes effect; empty otherwise

last_tier_change_date.meaning: date the most recent tier or cycle change took effect; the activation date when never changed

close_reason.meaning: how the membership ended; none while open

closed_date.meaning: date the membership ended; empty while open

membership_event_id.meaning: primary id of one membership ledger row

membership_id.meaning: membership the row belongs to (foreign key -> memberships)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, verbatim from the membership charter

period_start.meaning: first day of the period a charge, credit or grant concerns; empty on usage and expiry rows

period_end.meaning: last day of the period a charge covers; empty on other rows

dues_kind.meaning: what a charge is for; none on other rows

credit_reason.meaning: why dues were credited; none on other rows

amount.meaning: amount billed or credited; 0.00 on credit-ledger rows

credits.meaning: visit credits granted, used or expired; 0 on dues rows; direction on member_visit_credits comes from the event family

grant_reason.meaning: why credits were granted; none on other rows

encounter_number.meaning: encounter that used a credit; empty on other rows

service_type.meaning: kind of member visit that used a credit; none on other rows

expire_reason.meaning: why credits expired; none on other rows

membership_request_id.meaning: primary id of the membership request

membership_id.meaning: membership the request concerns (foreign key -> memberships)

requested_variant_name.meaning: target tier of a tier change; none for other requests

start_date.meaning: date the freeze or change is to take effect (a first day of a month)

months_requested.meaning: months of a freeze; 0 for other requests

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
